model_timing_contract.forward_definition: vision + text prefill + every autoregressive token forward; includes KV management and stop control
model_timing_contract.prefill_ms: CUDA elapsed: vision/text/state encoding to reusable prefix
model_timing_contract.decode_ms: CUDA elapsed: all generation steps including noise/sampling, before action restoration
model_timing_contract.gpu_inference_ms: CUDA elapsed across prefill plus complete decode; no intermediate synchronization
model_timing_contract.pure_inference_ms: synchronized wall time across the same model interval, including host dispatch
model_timing_contract.e2e_note: original CPU observation-to-action scope retained; includes profiling overhead

memory.note: RSS is process lifetime peak; on Thor CPU/GPU share physical memory, do not add these figures
